title: VW Beetle Engines by Year (1949–1979)
description: Every factory engine in the US air-cooled Volkswagen Beetle by year, 1949–1979: the 1100, 1200, 1300, 1500 and 1600 flat fours, carbureted and fuel-injected.
intro: Volkswagen sold the air-cooled Beetle in the US from 1949. The sedan, including the Super Beetle, left after 1977 and the convertible after 1979. Every engine was an air-cooled flat four in the back; ratings are the US figures, SAE gross until 1972 and net from 1973. The water-cooled New Beetle of 1998 on is a different car.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.
The 1300, then the 1500 and 1600, with fuel injection from 1975.
